name: Pragmatic Fashion Society
description:
Pragmatic Fashion Society, the official fashion club of our college, is a creative space where style meets self-expression. From fashion walks and theme-based shows to designing, modeling, and styling, we celebrate individuality and creativity.

We aim to provide students a platform to showcase their talent, confidence, and passion for fashion while working together as a team.
